reply.text:
That's a hard no from me on SARMs, and no dose. RAD140 is an investigational compound that isn't approved for any use, and what's sold online often isn't what the label says. Dosing it is a medical decision, not a training one, so if you're considering it, please talk to a doctor first, ideally one who can run bloodwork with you.

If the goal is adding muscle, I can help with the part that reliably works: progressive overload on your main lifts, enough protein across the day, and a sleep schedule you can actually hold. Tell me what you're bulking on right now and we'll look at where the room to grow is.
